text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "postHistory.Id is a dense per-revision-event identifier (1–386848) that trivially contains almost any small integer, so the 0.916 containment of votes.PostId (max 16921) is chance overlap, and the postHistory table's own PostId column shows that revision-event Ids name different entities (history events) than the posts that votes.PostId references."}
